description.en: Shared foundation and connector module for the EU DPP textile ontology network. It defines the common quantitative-value and reference-period patterns, the shared product-technology-level vocabulary, controlled provenance vocabularies, editorial annotations and weak cross-module annotation relations. Domain-specific operational relations remain in their domain modules.

comments.en: The BC/BAT/BNAT product-technology axis is shared here because it is used by more than one textile aspect module. Aspect-specific configurations remain in their own module and map to the shared level rather than duplicating it.
